player_prompt.intro:
Iraga dados Pemain {player_id} ring puteran {num_rounds} IteratedTwoThirdsAverage.
Sabilang puteran, kober ring angka sane magenah riantara {min_guess} miwah {max_guess}.
Sesampun kobersané makadadua, target nyané (2/3)x(rerata kobersané makadadua),
lan pemain sane kobersané paling makedek ring target nyané menang ring puteran nyané.
Masautin antuk kober Iraga ring format '[<number>]'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Format nénten valid; kirimang tebakan ragané pinaka [<number>].
invalid_move.out_of_range: Indiké punika patut wénten ring pantaraning {min_guess} miwah {max_guess}.

message.round_guesses: Pemain 0 ngira {guess0}; Pemain 1 ngira {guess1}. Dadosné Target punika: {target}.
